title: A Day to Remember & spr / spl / scr

scenes.t: {name} reads about Laila. It is spring, and Laila is playing outside.
She is spraying water and laughing as it makes a big splash.
She runs in the garden, playing with her toy car. The car spins fast and bumps into a rock, but it doesn't split — it just bounces back!
Laila smiles, sits down, and watches a funny cartoon on the screen.
Mona is learning how to ride her red bike. She is practicing every day in the garden after school.
First, she is holding the bike and walking with it. Then, she is pushing her feet on the pedals.
Now, she is riding around the garden path. She is feeling proud. Practice brings success!

items.a: spr — throw water in small drops.
